caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with a warm brown color and a polished finish. The chest has five drawers in total, with two smaller drawers at the top, two medium-sized drawers below, and one large drawer at the bottom. The top row also includes a central square drawer featuring a carved circular fan or sunburst motif. Each drawer, except the central one, has two ornate, gold-colored handles shaped like stylized leaves or scrolls. The chest stands on four short, cabriole legs with slight curves. The background is a plain, light beige color, with no additional objects or patterns present.
